description: Source code for AgentCore SSE stream iterator handling both synchronous and asynchronous server-sent events (SSE) streaming responses, parsing SSE lines into ModelResponse objects, managing stream state, and supporting iteration.

classes.name: AgentCoreSSEStreamIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for handling both sync and async SSE streaming responses from AgentCore, parsing SSE lines into ModelResponse objects, and managing stream state.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with an HTTP response and model name, setting up internal state.

methods.name: __iter__
methods.description: Initializes synchronous iteration by creating a line iterator lazily.

methods.name: __aiter__
methods.description: Initializes asynchronous iteration by creating an async line iterator lazily.

methods.name: _parse_sse_line
methods.description: Parses a single SSE line, extracting content delta, metadata, or message, and returns a ModelResponse chunk accordingly.

methods.name: _create_final_chunk
methods.description: Creates a final ModelResponse chunk signaling stream completion.

methods.name: __next__
methods.description: Performs synchronous iteration, parsing lines and yielding ModelResponse objects until stream ends.

methods.name: __anext__
methods.description: Performs asynchronous iteration, parsing lines and yielding ModelResponse objects until stream ends.
